notes.title: Bug Fixes & Updates - Patch Notes 0.4.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Patch Notes & Future Updates – Nothing Strange Here Demo[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Today we bring you the first official Patch Notes for the Nothing Strange Here Demo! There are still more bugs to fix, and additions to be made until we are satisfied with the Demo Experience. So there will be many more updates to come![/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ Patch Notes[/h3][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Audio Settings not showing correct values on start[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing Audio to Miklos Timeline, Footstep SFX on Tree Bridge, Cabin & Small Rocks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed music transitions between areas false trigger[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Barnie’s Dialogue sometimes not working in the Intro Cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock where you could get stuck in the Journal if you tried to open the Pause Menu while holding a Picture[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused the “E” prompt to stay on screen after interacting with the Notice Board[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a missing Sound on cats when they were jumping down[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where loading the game during the Tutorial could cause an empty page in the Quest part of the Journal[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could get stuck in an endless Dialogue-Loop with Uncle Barnie in the Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Dialogue progression being allowed while game paused[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed so Uncle Barnie’s neck does not break anymore during the Mine Cutscene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed so Dipshitto does not get stuck on the Awnis anymore[/p][/*][*][p]McTestalot should no longer be stuck in a Walking Animation anymore[/p][/*][*][p]The Snobby Lady is now holding the Leash to her Carrot[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing footstep SFX to multiple NPC’s[/p][/*][*][p]Mama Cadence now goes to bed at Night[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where you could no longer interact with Uncle Barnie during the tutorial if you talked to Barnie while having the Pause Menu active[/p][/*][*][p]Various improvements to the Nav Mesh[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]So you might be wondering then... What Comes Next?👀[/h3][p]We’re already working very hard on the next demo update, which will include:[/p][list][*][p]A new Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]A new Area[/p][/*][*][p]Critical UI Additions[/p][/*][*][p]Performance and quality-of-life updates[/p][/*][*][p]More Bug fixes of course![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]And remember, there are many secrets left to be found![/h3][p]Keep your camera ready, there’s always something strange around the corner to be found!
Thanks for playing [i]Nothing Strange Here[/i] and helping us shape the town of Larcenest Gap![/p][p][/p][p]💌 Also Join our Discord for sneak peeks and dev updates: [url="https://discord.gg/vvucbH7aK3"]https://discord.gg/vvucbH7aK3[/url][/p]

notes.title: 📰 Breaking News: Playtest #4 Demo Test
notes.content:
[h2]For this playtest, we’re hunting down as many bugs as possible (the non-Silksong kind). Your feedback is critical to the investigation please take a moment to submit your notes to the newsroom.[/h2][p][/p][p]Local reports insist that “everything is perfectly normal” in Larcenest Gap.
As the town’s newest investigative journalist, you may want to double-check that for yourself.[/p][p]While everyone else is busy filing glowing reviews of [i]Silksong[/i], our newsroom is opening its doors for one last assignment:[/p][p][b]Playtest #4: Demo Test[/b] begins [b]September 5th at 16:00 CEST[/b] and runs until [b]September 8th[/b] [b]00:00 PT / 09:00 CEST[/b].[/p][p][b]Your editor’s notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Interview people who have nothing unusual to say.[/p][/*][*][p]Snap photos, of completely “normal” things in our small town.[/p][/*][*][p]File your story before the presses roll.[/p][/*][/list][p]So if you need a break from bug battles, grab your notepad and camera the strange little town of Larcenest Gap is waiting for your coverage.[/p][p]
If you are a content creator feel free to request keys and join our campaign on [url="https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/3d803627"]Keymailer[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfuHHgJ3V0Af6GH-WJe0oOB0lcpKVwd5HKP1VXCkAAupKTl_A/viewform?usp=header" style="button"]Feedback[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest #3 Can You Hear That?
notes.content:
[h2]🗓️ [b]August 15–17[/b][/h2][h2]🕹️ [b]16:00 CEST to 00:00 PT / 09:00 CEST[/b][/h2][p]We’re finally back from summer vacation slightly sunburned, slightly bug-bitten, and definitely a little stranger than before. Turns out real life has its own bugs… and a world just as weird as the one we’re building.[/p][p]But we’re back in Larcenest Gap now and so are you.[/p][h2][b]🌼 What are we testing in Playtest #3:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]🎮 [b]Controller Support
[/b] You can now play with a controller! It’s still a work-in-progress (menus might act up), but it’s mostly functional. Let us know how it feels.[/p][/*][*][p]🎙️ [b]Voice Acting for Most Characters
[/b] Many of the town’s residents now speak some warmly, some suspiciously, some... unsettlingly calm. Voices are in and being tweaked, but already in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]📚 [b]Tutorial Quest – Dialogue & Environmental Outcomes
[/b] We’ve updated the tutorial quest with more branching outcomes and responsive world events. Your choices echo a little louder now.[/p][/*][*][p]🪲 [b]Bug Fixes (Both Kinds)
[/b] We squashed plenty of in-game bugs  and a few that bit us outdoors. More will surely emerge. You know the drill.[/p][/*][/list][h2]🎥 About the Camera[/h2][p]We’re still working on improving the camera.
Some players in previous playtests reported [b]motion sickness[/b], which is absolutely [i]not[/i] the kind of “sick” experience we’re aiming for.[/p][p]Our goal is for [i]Nothing Strange Here[/i] to be [b]sick and fun not the kind that makes you queasy.[/b] We’re actively adjusting movement and camera smoothing to keep things cozy, not dizzy.[/p][p]Please let us know if you’re still feeling woozy this time around. Your feedback helps us get it right.[/p][h2][b]🧠 Why This Test Matters:[/b][/h2][p]This round focuses on [b]feel[/b]  how the game sounds, controls, and reacts. Voice acting, input systems, and consequence feedback are all crucial as we move toward full demo release.[/p][p]Your thoughts will help us shape a more expressive, cozy, and uncanny experience.[/p][h2][b]💬 Help Shape the Game:[/b][/h2][p]🐣 [url="https://discord.gg/xhKjksEEED"]\[Join Our Discord][/url]
📝 [url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeT4ZgYCvJMtBiZe07KQ5YfKuVLvAmDskyV9YsC9WSAWSUQPQ/viewform?usp=header"]\[Leave Feedback on Playtest #3][/url][/p][p]Thanks for helping us keep [i]Nothing Strange Here[/i]… just the right amount of strange.
 — [b]The Dandelion Developers Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🔍 Playtests Have Begun And the Story’s Just Starting
notes.content:
[h3]Something strange is happening in Larcenest Gap and now you can step in to see for yourself.[/h3][p]This is just the beginning: we’ll be running [b]bi-weekly playtests[/b] to gather feedback, squash bugs, and fine-tune the weirdness.[/p][p]🧪 [b]Playtest Schedule
[/b]Here’s when the town will be open:[/p][p][b]First General Playtest [/b][/p][p]🗓️ [b]July 4–6[/b] 17:00 CEST to 00:00 PT / 09:00 CEST [b](new start time)[/b] [/p][p][b]Quest Board Outcomes[/b][/p][p]🗓️ [b]July 18–20[/b]  16:00 CEST to 00:00 PT / 09:00 CEST[/p][p][b]Steam Deck & Controller Testing, Remaining Quest Outcomes, Pre-Demo Bugs[/b][/p][p]🗓️ [b]August 15–17[/b]  16:00 CEST to 00:00 PT / 09:00 CEST[/p][p][/p][p]Each session gives us a chance to test new content, fix what’s broken, and collect your thoughts.[/p][p]🔍 Explore the town
📸 Document strange discoveries
🧷 Unlock stickers and secrets
💬 Share feedback and shape the mystery[/p][p]We’ll post reminders before each test and if you have feedback, bug reports, or sticker ideas, we’re all ears.[/p][p]See you in the Gap…[/p][p][b]💬 Got feedback? We’re listening.[/b][/p][p]Spotted a bug? Loved a quest? Got confused by something weird (or not weird [i]enough[/i])?[/p][p]Drop your thoughts[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/SQ54YScduGmiRzWN7" style="button"]HERE[/url][/p][p][b]💫 Enjoyed your time in the Gap?[/b][/p][p]Hit [b]Wishlist[/b] and [b]Follow[/b] if you haven’t already. It helps us reach more curious players who might just love getting lost in the strange, too.[/p][p][b]🕵️‍♀️ Wanna be part of the investigation?[/b][/p][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/AzCJUH8KF6"]Discord [/url]to share theories, report oddities, and chat with the devs (and other nosy reporters).[/p][p]
